# ODCS JSON schema (vendored for tests)

`odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0-20251208.json` is copied unchanged from
https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard, `schema/` at commit 7c7597ee04ec58f67ea4a9cbcddab2043ff7d01f
(17 November 2026), read 23 November 2026 by round BL38. The Open Data Contract Standard is licensed under Apache 2.0
(`LICENSE-open-data-contract-standard.txt` beside this file, from the same commit). `tests/test_bl38_data_contract.py` validates the contracts
`fabric_backend/data_contract.py` writes against it.
